presentation.title: Town Hall 19 update coming very soon!
presentation.summary: The Town Hall 19 Update is ready, and should be live within the next couple days

sections.title: What to expect
sections.body: Town hall 19 is now out! With it comes many new exciting content changes. And unfortunately, these changes break my app until I update it for the new town hall. So I have been working hard today to bring support for all the new content in the update, as well as all of the cost and time reductions, for the best accuracy and experience.

sections.title: What's new
sections.body: Alongside the new content from within the game, I am also releasing some changes I have been working on. An overhaul to multi-account management is coming. You can now prioritize profiles, and reorder them in the settings tab. This will impact the all new multi account widgets, which display 6 upgrades, prioritizing upgrades from your starred accounts. I've also added the first large (4x4) widget for multi account management.

sections.title: Performance Improvements
sections.body: What started as a basic widget utility, has now become a much larger project. And since the initial release, there has been very little focus on optimization and performace. So a sweep has been done of the app, and there have been many enhancements to prevent the app from freezing and lagging, as well as to prevent stutters while scrolling. Hopefully this will improve the experience on all devices. Clash On!

presentation.title: Hammer Jam has started!
presentation.summary: Hammer Jam is live! Check the Hammer Jam event on Home for the dates, discounts, and farming boosts.

sections.title: Supercharge fix coming soon
sections.body: A Clashboard update is expected in the next 1–2 days with a fix for tracking Supercharge upgrade-time reductions. Until then, your current app version may not reflect those reductions correctly.

presentation.title: Big Update - Share and view your village progress!
presentation.summary: Clashboard just got more social! Introducing the new progress tab. Easily track all your Home village levels, and click the share button at the top to get a shareable image of your progress for lab or equipment (buildings and builder base coming soon).

sections.title: Event Support
sections.body: Clashboard now supports in game events, so that when there is a new event, it will be visible to you with all the details you need. Stay tuned for hammer jam, clashboard will show you the boosts provided by hammer jam, as well as all the details before it starts.

sections.title: iPhone Duo Support
sections.body: Clashboard supports the all new iphone duo, with a new layout that takes advantage of both the inner and cover screen, as well as the new UI that comes with it.
